name: @dreamteamer/setup
description: dt-setup — one board for every official dreamteamer module a workspace has: what is ready, what is degraded, and the fix for each.

dreamteamer.title: Setup
dreamteamer.description: The board across modules. `dt-setup doctor` reads which official modules the workspace has, on every channel, and reports each one's optional capabilities as READY, DEGRADED or UNAVAILABLE with the fix inline: calendar access for meetings, ffmpeg and model weights for recordings, Docker for contact enrichment, qmd and notebooklm-py for notebooks, an Asana token for perspective. `dt-setup setup` does only the in-workspace edits that board asks for — the template variables, `.env.example`, the record guards chained into `npm run check` — and prints everything else for a person to run. `dt-setup link <clone>` previews a local clone of these modules in place of the published ones, with a pre-commit guard while it is on. Ships no content.
